notes.title: Steam Release Date Set: Oct 31st, Halloween
notes.notes:
We have an official release date! You Must be 18 or Older to Enter will be out on Steam on October 31st, Halloween. Honestly, is there any scarier game than one about discovering porn? Before you ring doorbells for supernatural sweet treats, or maybe once you've gathered enough, slink off and relive this titillating childhood experience.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/608510/You_Must_be_18_or_Older_to_Enter/] Make sure to wishlist it 	[/url], and don't get caught!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30722177/ea44de689a7145cd94f630b70202cbbef73e7501.gif[/img]
